summary: Iteration 36 — Manager Money Access permission flag. BACKEND: 25/25 passed (1 skipped). All API behaviour correct: money_access persists on POST/PUT/GET /co-owners and /co-owners/shared-with-me; /auth/me returns acting_as.money=false; /api/project exposes money_hidden=true with every money scalar zeroed (total_budget, purchase_price, estimated_valuation, total_spent, home_finance.*); /api/projects shared row zeroed+money_hidden; 403 on /line-items, /receipts, /quotes, /stage-payments, /rentals, /project/comparables, /project/share and POST /ai/estimate; 200 on /milestones, /snags, /media, /documents, /contacts; PUT /api/project with purchase_price does NOT change owner's value; /api/portfolio/rent-roll excludes the shared project; public /api/t/{token} and /api/q/{token} bypass block_money (no bearer passes HTTPBearer(auto_error=False) + block_money early-returns); switching money_access True on PUT restores 200 and money_hidden disappears. FRONTEND OWNER /co-owners screen: invite-money-full / invite-money-tasks chips present, invite-role-co-owner / invite-role-manager present, co-owner-role-{id} shows 'Manager · <project> · tasks only (no money)' for tasks-only and 'Co-owner · all projects · full access' for full co-owner, co-owner-scope-{id} edit opens edit-money-{id}-full/tasks chips, co-owner-scope-save-{id} persists money_access change (verified via API), co-owner-limit-{id} present on full co-owner card. FRONTEND TASKS-ONLY MANAGER: BROKEN — Budget tab is still visible, hero shows project-total-spent (not project-stage-progress), budget-details-link, receipts-see-all, add-expense-button, media-tab-receipts, AI cost / Receipt / Share quick actions all still render. Root cause isolated below.

ui_bugs.issue: Budget tab remains visible when signed in as tasks-only manager because user.acting_as is not populated on fresh login (see RCA).

project-total-spent, budget-details-link, receipts-see-all, add-expense-button, rent-yield-* still render for tasks-only manager; project-stage-progress is missing. Same RCA: user.acting_as.money comes back undefined from /auth/login.
quick-action-ai, quick-action-brrr, quick-action-report (share), quick-action-receipt not filtered out for tasks-only manager (same RCA).
media-tab-receipts chip still renders for tasks-only manager (same RCA).

integration_issues.issue: POST /auth/login (and /auth/register) returns user_out(u) without the effective() wrapper → the response user object has acting_as = null. Frontend auth.tsx stores this on login and never refetches /auth/me, so useCanSeeMoney() returns true (default). All money-gated UI stays visible. Backend /auth/me returns the correct acting_as.money=false but the frontend only calls /auth/me on cold-start token restore, not after signIn/signUp.

action_items: FIX /app/backend/routes/auth.py — both /auth/register and /auth/login must return user_out(u, await effective(u)) so acting_as (including .money) is populated for freshly-logged-in co-owners/managers. One-liner for each endpoint.

Alternatively (defence in depth) in /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx handle(): after setApiToken + setUser, call `setUser(await api<User>('/auth/me'))` so the UI always has the effective view regardless of what /auth/login returns.

After the fix, re-run frontend verification for tasks-only manager: tab-budget absent, project-stage-progress visible, project-total-spent/add-expense-button/budget-details-link/receipts-see-all/media-tab-receipts/quick-action-ai|brrr|report|receipt absent.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/auth.py register & login return user_out(u) only — missing effective(u) wrapper (RCA of all tasks-only UI bugs).

deps.block_money() correctly early-returns when there is no bearer, so public /q/{token} and /t/{token} are reachable without auth; verified by /api/t/not-a-real-token returning 404 (route reached) rather than 403.
deps.hide_money() zeroes nested home_finance values recursively and keeps structure (project doesn't crash the UI).
projects.PUT /api/project drops money keys for no_money users (line 153) so manager can't overwrite owner's purchase_price — verified by test.
server.py applies block_money dep on budget/quotes/stage_payments/ai/rentals/tenant_portal/share routers plus explicit dep on /project/comparables — covers all 8 endpoints from the spec.
Frontend money.ts hook is 1 line and correct; the bug is purely that user.acting_as is never fed into it after login because of the backend omission above.

co-owners.tsx MoneyToggle uses testPrefix pattern — invite-money-{full|tasks} and edit-money-{cid}-{full|tasks} both exist, co-owner-limit-{id} shown only when editing.full, co-owner-scope-save-{id} invokes PUT /co-owners/{id} with {project_ids, money_access} — matches backend contract.
deps.effective sets owner.no_money from share.money_access which is read in projects.get_project and projects.list_projects (hide_money applied) — single source of truth.

rca_of_issue: BUG: Tasks-only manager UI shows all money sections after fresh login.  REPRODUCTION: 1) Owner POST /api/co-owners {email, project_ids:[pid], money_access:false}. 2) Manager POST /api/projects/{pid}/activate. 3) Manager POST /api/auth/login → inspect response.user.acting_as — it is null even though /api/auth/me returns acting_as={owner_id,owner_name,money:false}. 4) Frontend /src/auth.tsx handle() sets user = response.user and never calls /auth/me afterwards. 5) useCanSeeMoney() reads user?.acting_as?.money !== false → `undefined !== false` → true → every money gate renders.  ROOT CAUSE: /app/backend/routes/auth.py lines 29 and 37 call user_out(u) without the effective() wrapper that /auth/me uses on line 42.  FIX: `return {"access_token": make_token(u.id), "user": user_out(u, await effective(u))}` for both register and login. Alternatively (or in addition) make frontend auth.tsx handle() call refresh() after storing the token.
